threatModel.assets: Owner budget data, task-bound model artifacts, historical financial and source evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated owner readback versus paid dispatch; model-generated inert artifacts versus independent technical review and Work publication.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged owner/workspace, unknown counting exposure released, old receipts reinterpreted, schema omissions, incomplete criteria, invented evidence and false acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Existing owner and exact-input checks; pure explanatory accounting with releasable zero; opt-in bounded report fields, complete criteria mapping, source refs, unchanged proposal/code/authority guards.

rollback: Revert this exact feature commit and requalify Preview without changing main/Production. Keep paid flags disabled and all stopped historical approvals revoked; never revert immutable journal records.

negativePaths.concurrency: Count dispatch and count recording are one-use existing-CAS operations; duplicate winners cannot occur.
negativePaths.cancellation: Shared owner/task/revoke/lease checks run after counting and before dispatch; whole-operation abort includes count requests.

negativePaths.authorization-denial: Missing count consent/server pricing pin, impersonated roles or substituted workspace/source deny; no model-granted permissions.
